hook.name: OmniPriceHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as a threshold-signed global price market maker: removes its straddle book position before each swap, JIT-mints a one-tick fill band at an oracle-converted USD reference price with a dynamic LP fee override, then harvests the band and rebuilds the book afterward. External liquidity providers are blocked; only the hook's own positions are allowed.
